add_hint: A Telegram ID or @username links the person's Telegram; a name makes an account without one. The account gets a VPN profile.
login_hint: 3–32 Latin letters, digits, _ . or -. The old login stays reserved for 30 days.
role_hint_owner: Everything, including roles and other owners.
roles_confirm_none: Take every staff role from this account?
passkeys_confirm: Remove every passkey of this account? It signs in with its password or Telegram.
sessions_confirm: Sign this account out on every device?
workstations_confirm: Unlink every Workstation this account linked through the relay? They stop working at once.
sign_in_link_hint: A one-time link that signs the person in as this account, for a week: to set a password or add a passkey.
invite_once: Send this to the person. It is shown only now and works once.
block_hint: A blocked account cannot sign in or use the bot. VPN access stays; freeze the profile to stop it.
blocked_hint: The account is blocked: it cannot sign in or use the bot.
done_sessions: The account is signed out everywhere.
approve_confirm: Approve {name}? The account and its VPN profile are created.
intake_hint: When it is off, the bot tells newcomers that requests are closed.
invite_note_hint: who it is for, seen only by staff
invite_bot_bound: The Telegram link works while the bot is @{bot}.
revoke_confirm: Revoke this invite? Its link stops working.
bot_username_hint: Invite links for Telegram name the bot; set it after renaming the bot.
registration_open: Anyone may make an account with a login
registration_hint: The new account has no access: people ask for it from the cabinet.
registration_cleanup: Remove registered accounts left empty after, days
merge_vpn_moves: The VPN profile moves to the main account.
merge_telegram_moves: Telegram moves to the main account.
merge_telegram_dropped: The main account keeps its Telegram.
merge_password_moves: The password moves to the main account.
merge_password_dropped: The main account keeps its password.
merge_login_moves: The login moves to the main account.
merge_login_dropped: The main account keeps its login.
merge_passkeys: {count} passkeys of the joining account are removed.
merge_keep: Both have VPN: which profile stays?
merge_keep_main_only: A staff account's VPN never expires and is kept.
merge_approve_confirm: Merge the accounts? The joining one is deleted; this cannot be undone.
